scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.vercel-build: sh -c 'if [ -n "$DATABASE_URL" ]; then echo "Pushing database schema..."; pnpm --filter @workspace/db run push && (pnpm --filter @workspace/db run seed || echo "Coupon seed skipped (non-fatal)"); else echo "DATABASE_URL not set — skipping schema push"; fi' && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/freshlux run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
